description: This Kotlin source file defines the ProfileRepository class, which manages user connection profiles stored in SharedPreferences. It provides methods to add, retrieve, and update profiles, handling default profile logic and persistence as JSON. It also implements singleton pattern for repository access.

classes.name: ProfileRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing connection profiles stored in SharedPreferences, supporting add, get, update operations, and singleton access.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ProfileRepository using application context.

methods.name: addProfile
methods.description: Creates and persists a new profile, optionally setting it as default.

methods.name: getProfileById
methods.description: Retrieves a profile by its UUID string id.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates an existing profile's details and default status.

methods.name: loadProfilesFromPrefs
methods.description: Loads profiles from SharedPreferences, parsing JSON array.

methods.name: saveProfilesToPrefs
methods.description: Saves the list of profiles to SharedPreferences as JSON.
